 About the match
 On this page you can find the Inter Miami vs FC Cincinnati match lineup for Major League Soccer — Round 32 - Second Leg, on Thursday 29-10-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Inter Miami lines up in a 4-3-3 led by Messi, while FC Cincinnati sets up in a 3-5-2 led by Evander. Inter Miami is led by head coach Kily González, while FC Cincinnati is managed by Pat Noonan. The match is played at Nu Stadium.
